title: Solid city 4 of 4: in a collapsed apartment block the Tiger climbs the rubble until a crest comes up under its belly, and hangs there
input_audit: The Tiger is placed 10 m in front of the partly collapsed five-storey apartment block urban_intro.c2r0.r00, facing it. Commander head-out from 1.8 s; from 2.5 s the throttle is held at 0.6 to the end. Walls are ground, the hull climbs the rubble of the collapsed bays, and a crest of that rubble reaches the 0.47 m belly: from then on every move that would press the belly further into it is refused, so the tank stays where it is with its engine working. Nothing is injected.
historical_scope: The generated urban-intro district (docs/URBAN_INTRO_20260928.md) under its inspection lighting copy (sun 32 degrees, exposure 8) for judging form; a mechanics verification film, not a historical engagement.
